task: round 12 scan_hyp_redteam_e10: red-team the E10 night procedure + copy-paste command sequence + ideas
summary: Red team of the E10 night procedure (v1 >= 0.956 in force; v2 >= 0.954 proposed). Every failure mode found ends in 'no port' with the ticked finals #37 + #38 unchanged; the harmful paths are a wrong-version port, an unenforced SKIP and an insertion-family successor replacing the twin. Measured fixes: (1) pages show the last SUCCESSFUL version while pull returns the latest; bind with get_kernel().metadata.current_version_number (x138 1, HF v3 5, amanatar 5 vs page 'Version 1 of 5', anhad 9 vs 'Version 6 of 9'); (2) `kernels output owner/slug/N` ignores N; (3) e10_port_gate exits 0 with SKIPs and its group summary hides them ('csv PASS' + '[SKIP] csv: ours'), so step 7 must grep FAIL|SKIP == 0; (4) the gate run with --dummy on the author's own output pre-checks the log before GPU is spent (HF v3: PASS, 62 forks, 16.8 min). v2 amendments to fold in before its OK (pre-trigger): insertion-family successor (forks > 62 on the 4 dummy clips) -> notify and wait; simultaneous or equal-score triggers -> highest score, ties notify; dataset updated after the scored run or blank docker/machine -> P3 FAIL. A copy-paste command sequence (trigger -> pull -> sanitise -> static gate -> author output -> push -> full gate -> submit -> SELECTED -> ledger -> notify) with expected outputs is in the JSON. No scoring mechanism reaches R8; finals unchanged.

findings.what: Version binding. Kaggle notebook pages show the LAST SUCCESSFUL version, while `kernels pull` returns the LATEST version and writes no version number. P4b(c) cannot be checked with the recorded commands. The API field get_kernel().metadata.current_version_number, read in the same process as the pull, makes it mechanical: page 'Version k of M' with k == M == the API value before and after the pull.

Pages: amanatar 'Version 1 of 5' (0.910) while the pulled source sha256 96387e7858e6 = the errored latest (experiments/ext_optimized-biohub-max-score/v10_2026-09-26); anhadmahajan06 'Version 6 of 9' (round 11/12 browser). get_kernel().metadata.last_run_time = 2026-09-23 20:04 for all four (bogus). kaggle 2.2.4 kaggle_api_extended.py l.6603-6622 (metadata dump has no version).
findings.action: Tested 20:12Z in the scratchpad on x138: steps 2-4 print version_before 1 version_after 1 sha256 6b655e39bbfd2d3d (= the pinned X138_SHA256), no blank docker/machine, static gate rc=0, 0 FAIL, exactly 4 SKIP. Use step 2 of the command sequence (Python heredoc; no tool change) at every trigger; record version_before/after and sha256 in <pull dir>/e10_pull.json. This implements P4b(c) and needs no new OK.

findings.what: `kaggle kernels output <owner>/<slug>/<N>` silently ignores N and serves the latest session. So the author CSV and log can come from a later version than the one pulled.
findings.evidence: kaggle 2.2.4 kaggle_api_extended.py l.6640-6745: parse_kernel_string returns the version, but ApiListKernelSessionOutputRequest gets only user_name + kernel_slug. The whole file is read into RAM (requests.get(...).content). --file-pattern exists. The dry-run author output was 52 MB with edge_cache/secondary_seed_weights/tracking_repo and took ~3 min.

findings.what: tools/e10_port_gate.py exits 0 when some lines are SKIP. Its group summary also hides a SKIP when the same group has a PASS: it printed 'csv PASS' next to '[SKIP] csv: ours'. E10 v2 asks for '0 FAIL and 0 SKIP' before the submit, so neither the exit code nor the summary can be used as the check.

findings.what: Successor = x138 + a division insertion (our K2 family). E10 v2 V4 would pair it with #37 automatically. Both finals would then carry an insertion-type mechanism and the no-insertion twin would be dropped, which is the objection that rejected SI in round 11. A fork count classifies it cheaply: x138 has 62 forks on the 4 dummy clips and K2 has 74.

findings.action: Before the user's v2 OK (and before 27 Sep 12:00 UTC; it is pre-trigger, so not post-hoc), add one line to the PROPOSED v2 text: 'author CSV forks on the 4 dummy clips > 62, or a division-add stage in the diff vs exp56 -> notify and wait, no autonomous port'. command_sequence:
E10 NIGHT PORT - COPY-PASTE SEQUENCE (Git Bash; tools used as they are; every step read-only except PUSH and SUBMIT)
R=/c/Users/vital/Documents/kAGGLE/Biohub\ -\ Cell\ Tracking\ During\ Development ; cd "$R"

# 0 PREFLIGHT (every P1 check, ~1 min)
date -u
python tools/e10_snapshot.py; echo "rc=$?"
#   expect: '======== DIFF vs <prev>.txt ========' ... last line 'E10-P1 SNAPSHOT experiments/e10_watch/<YYYYMMDDTHHMMZ>.txt CHANGES=<n>', rc=0.
#   rc=1 = a CLI call failed after 3 tries: rerun once; still 1 -> no port this window, note it.
python - <<'EOF'
import datetime as d
h=[l for l in open('experiments/lb_poll/poll.log',encoding='utf-8') if l.startswith('=== ')][-1]
t=d.datetime.strptime(h[4:24],'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ').replace(tzinfo=d.timezone.utc)
print(h.strip(),'age_min=%.1f'%((d.datetime.now(d.timezone.utc)-t).total_seconds()/60))
EOF
#   expect age_min < 15. Else 0b.
python -c "from kaggle.api.kaggle_api_extended import KaggleApi; from kagglesdk.competitions.types.competition_enums import SubmissionGroup as G; a=KaggleApi(); a.authenticate(); print(sorted(s.ref for s in a.competition_submissions('biohub-cell-tracking-during-development', group=G.SUBMISSION_GROUP_SELECTED)))"
#   expect ['56563521', '56563534']
grep -n "E10 v2" CONTEXT.md | grep -iE "USER OK|IN FORCE since"
#   no line -> the threshold is 0.956 (v1). A 0.954-0.955 successor is then notify-only.
#   Chrome: mcp tabs_context_mcp must answer. Not connected + a real P2 signal -> PushNotification 'E10: <ref> changed, Chrome disconnected, waiting' and STOP (P4c(7)).
# 0b POLLER RESTART (PowerShell; lb_poll.py uses a RELATIVE log path, so the working directory matters)
#   Start-Process -FilePath python -ArgumentList 'experiments/lb_poll/lb_poll.py' -WorkingDirectory 'C:\Users\vital\Documents\kAGGLE\Biohub - Cell Tracking During Development' -WindowStyle Hidden
#   then re-run the age check after ~1 min: expect a new '=== <now>' header, age_min < 2.

# 1 TRIGGER (browser, read-only): on https://www.kaggle.com/code/<A>/<S> record 'Version k of M' and 'Public Score' SC.
#   Go on only if k == M (the page shows the LAST SUCCESSFUL version: amanatar showed 'Version 1 of 5' while the pull returned v5 ERROR),
#   SC >= threshold, and the notebook is x138-family. PushNotification 'E10 trigger: <A>/<S> vM public SC; gating now'.
A=<author>; S=<slug>; M=<M from page>; SC=<score>; STAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%MZ)
D=experiments/ext_$S/e10_$STAMP ; P=experiments/exp63_succ_$A ; O=_dl/e10_author_$A ; Q=_dl/biohub-exp63-succ-$A

# 2 PULL, VERSION-BOUND (the CLI pull does not write the version; get_kernel carries it)
python - "$A" "$S" "$D" <<'EOF'
import sys,json,hashlib,glob
from kaggle.api.kaggle_api_extended import KaggleApi
from kagglesdk.kernels.types.kernels_api_service import ApiGetKernelRequest
A,S,D=sys.argv[1:4]; a=KaggleApi(); a.authenticate()
def ver():
    with a.build_kaggle_client() as k:
        r=ApiGetKernelRequest(); r.user_name=A; r.kernel_slug=S
        return k.kernels.kernels_api_client.get_kernel(r).metadata.current_version_number
v0=ver(); a.kernels_pull(f"{A}/{S}", path=D, metadata=True); v1=ver()
nb=glob.glob(D+'/*.ipynb')[0]; sha=hashlib.sha256(open(nb,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
json.dump({'ref':f'{A}/{S}','version_before':v0,'version_after':v1,'ipynb':nb,'sha256':sha},open(D+'/e10_pull.json','w'),indent=1)
print('version_before',v0,'version_after',v1,'sha256',sha[:16])
EOF
#   expect version_before == version_after == M. Otherwise: the author pushed meanwhile -> re-read the page; no port on a mismatch.
#   (metadata.last_run_time from get_kernel is bogus: 2026-09-23 20:04 for every kernel on 26 Sep; never use it.)

# 3 SANITISE METADATA (P4b(a))
mkdir -p "$P" && cp "$D"/*.ipynb "$P"/
python - "$D" "$P" "$A" <<'EOF'
import json,sys
D,P,A=sys.argv[1:4]; A=A.lower()
m=json.load(open(D+'/kernel-metadata.json',encoding='utf-8'))
bad=[k for k in ('docker_image','machine_shape') if not m.get(k)]
m.pop('id_no',None); m['id']='vitaliineibauer/biohub-exp63-succ-'+A; m['title']='biohub exp63 succ '+A
m['is_private']=True; m['enable_internet']=False
for k in ('dataset_sources','model_sources','competition_sources'): m[k]=[s for s in (m.get(k) or []) if isinstance(s,str) and s.strip()]
json.dump(m,open(P+'/kernel-metadata.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),indent=2)
print('BLANK docker/machine (proposed FAIL):',bad); print(json.dumps(m,indent=1))
EOF
#   expect: BLANK ... [] ; id vitaliineibauer/biohub-exp63-succ-<a>; docker_image gcr.io/kaggle-private-byod/python@sha256:... and machine_shape NvidiaTeslaT4 for x138-family.
for r in $(python -c "import json;print(' '.join(json.load(open('$P/kernel-metadata.json'))['dataset_sources']))"); do
  python -m kaggle datasets files "$r" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "LISTABLE $r" || echo "P3 FAIL $r"; done
#   expect LISTABLE for every source (x138 family: 4 pilkwang/anvithpothula datasets). Any 'P3 FAIL' -> no port.
#   drift (proposed): python -m kaggle datasets list --user <owner> -s <slug> -v  -> lastUpdated must be before the page date of version M.

# 4 STATIC GATE
python tools/e10_port_gate.py --pulled "$D" --port "$P" --version $M > "$P/gate_static.txt"; echo "rc=$?"
grep -c '^\[FAIL\]' "$P/gate_static.txt"; grep '^\[SKIP\]' "$P/gate_static.txt"
#   expect rc=0, FAIL count 0, exactly 4 SKIP lines (dummy-log; csv ours; csv author; node-counts). Any FAIL -> no port (log the line).

# 5 AUTHOR OUTPUT + PRE-DUMMY LOG CHECK (before spending GPU)
python -m kaggle kernels output "$A/$S" -p "$O" --file-pattern '^submission\.csv$'
#   expect 'Output file downloaded to _dl/e10_author_<a>/submission.csv' and 'Kernel log downloaded to _dl/e10_author_<a>/<S>.log'.
#   The CLI IGNORES a /<version> suffix and always serves the LATEST session: re-run step 2's ver() now; it must still be M.
python tools/e10_port_gate.py --pulled "$D" --port "$P" --dummy "$O" --author "$O" --version $M | grep -E '^\[(PASS|FAIL|SKIP)\] (dummy-log|csv)|forks|RESULT'
#   expect dummy-log PASS on the AUTHOR's own log ('VALIDATOR: disabled (BIOHUB_VALIDATOR_ENABLE=0).', 'enabled=False'), csv PASS,
#   'N nodes in 4 clips, E edges, F forks'. Record F (x138 = 62 on the 4 dummy clips; K2 = 74). A FAIL here = our dummy would fail too -> stop.

# 6 PUSH PRIVATE DUMMY
python -m kaggle kernels list --mine --sort-by dateRun --page-size 5 -v    # at most 1 own GPU session running (2-session limit)
python -m kaggle kernels push -p "$P"
#   expect 'Kernel version 1 successfully pushed.  Please check progress at https://www.kaggle.com/code/vitaliineibauer/biohub-exp63-succ-<a>'
#   note the version V printed (1 for a new slug). A quota/limit error text -> no port (V2 needs the dummy); PushNotification it.
#   wait (Monitor until-loop, ~5 min steps): python -m kaggle kernels status vitaliineibauer/biohub-exp63-succ-$A
#   expect QUEUED (dry run: >= 5 min) -> RUNNING -> 'has status "KernelWorkerStatus.COMPLETE"' after ~17-30 min (author visible run 16.8 min).
#   ERROR -> no port; keep the log.

# 7 DUMMY OUTPUT + FULL GATE
python -m kaggle kernels output vitaliineibauer/biohub-exp63-succ-$A -p "$Q" --file-pattern '^submission\.csv$'
